name: aspect-ratio
description: A box that keeps a fixed width to height ratio.
usage: # Aspect Ratio A box that keeps a fixed width to height ratio. ## Usage ```gx ``` ## Do - Set `Ratio` as a CSS ratio, for example `16 / 9`. - Let the child fill the box with `size-full`. ## Don't - Do not use an aspect ratio for text content. - Do not nest aspect ratio boxes. ## Keyboard | Key | Action | | --- | --- | | None | The component is static. |
